trends.name: Iran-US Military Conflict Escalation
trends.summary: Trump to address nation Wednesday on Iran war update amid drone attacks on Iraqi oil fields and rising Middle East tensions. Australia and Japan already signaling economic concerns. Real-time X posts show oil market volatility and geopolitical risk dominating trader sentiment with Trump war-exit comments creating significant uncertainty.

trends.name: Oil Price Volatility Near $100
trends.summary: Brent crude oscillating around $98-100 on Trump war comments and drone attacks on Duhok oil field. Massive energy ETF inflows (largest since Russia-Ukraine) paired with record single-stock energy outflows signal sector confusion. UK fuel supply critical—last jet fuel vessel arriving in 48 hours.

trends.name: Tech Giants Face Iran Attack Threats
trends.summary: Iran threatens military action against Nvidia, Apple and other tech giants, elevating geopolitical risk to semiconductor and consumer tech sectors. Combined with broader Middle East conflict fears, this creates additional downside pressure on mega-cap tech stocks already under scrutiny.

trends.name: Nike Turnaround Stalls on China Weakness
trends.summary: Nike shares plunge 9% on weak guidance with expected 20% China sales decline, signaling turnaround is farther away than investors hoped. Stock remains unattractive despite weak outlook, indicating broader apparel sector and China exposure concerns for consumer discretionary investors.

trends.name: AI Investment Thesis Expanding
trends.summary: Five-star managers identify next hot AI plays beyond mega-cap stocks, suggesting investors are underestimating breadth of AI opportunity. Market appears early in pricing secondary AI beneficiaries across infrastructure, software, and specialized chip plays.

trends.name: Banking Credit Risk Under Scrutiny
trends.summary: Muddy Waters short-selling firm pivoting to target credit markets, raising alarm about credit quality and counterparty risk. Citigroup on hold rating with mixed margin outlook adds to banking sector concerns amid uncertain economic backdrop.

trends.name: JPMorgan Eyes Prediction Markets Entry
trends.summary: Jamie Dimon signals JPMorgan could eventually enter prediction markets, suggesting major financial institutions exploring new asset classes and trading venues. Signals regulatory shift and institutional appetite for alternative markets.

trends.name: GLP-1 Drug Adoption Accelerating
trends.summary: Novo Nordisk shares rise sharply after Wegovy recommended by UK's drug price regulator, validating GLP-1 sector expansion into obesity treatment. Signals regulatory tailwind and broader healthcare/pharma rerating as obesity drugs achieve mainstream medical credibility.

trends.name: Yen Weakness Triggers FX Intervention Risk
trends.summary: Yen briefly weakens past 160 per USD for first time since July 2024, approaching intervention threshold where Japan's Ministry of Finance last acted. Rising FX intervention risk could roil currency markets and create volatility for JPY-exposed trades.

trends.name: Cash Alternatives & Rate Stability Demand
trends.summary: Investors rotating toward stability with SGOV and Treasury alternatives as market uncertainty peaks. Tax-bracket management and bond income strategies gaining prominence as investors seek alternatives to equity volatility amid geopolitical uncertainty.

trends.name: Market Timing Signals Early Conflict Bottom
trends.summary: Tom Lee strategist note: stock markets typically bottom in early stages of military conflict. Asian equities and govt bonds already surging on peace hopes, with Nikkei jumping 4% on Trump war-end comments, suggesting early positioning into recovery.

trends.name: NATO Withdrawal Risk Dominates Political Trading
trends.summary: Trump signals consideration of pulling US from NATO as 'paper tiger,' creating major geopolitical and defense sector uncertainty. Combined with Iran war escalation and Middle East posturing (UAE preparing Hormuz military action), geopolitical regime shift is full-time trader focus.
